Right now, even though you're unhappy, you're looking the other way, settling for the easy path, or clinging to the way things are. Don't
be afraid of change--let's look for a better way. If you can't find the answer, talk to those around you. If you don't change

abilities you currently possess. Money: You're in a position to manage your finances with moderation. Health: Lead a balanced, healthy

341710.【節制】の逆位置は バランスが崩れ\n周囲との 折り合いがつかない状態を示します:

341719.【塔】の正位置は 衝撃的なことが起こるが\n対処しだいで 好転が可能だと示してい:

Money: Unexpected expenses--no need to fret; review your budget. Health: Watch out for accidents or sudden illnesses--be prepared in

341720.あなたは 避けようのない 大きな出来事から \n強いショックを 受けてしまいそう:
You're likely to be deeply shaken by a major, unavoidable event. Whether it's an unexpected problem or a mishap... stay strong and try to

341722.【塔】の逆位置は 予期せぬトラブルが\n後を引き 動揺が長引くと 示しています。:

Lingering confusion--settle your accounts without fear. Health: Persistent symptoms-- identify the cause early. Today's Fortune: Try

Health: Positive thinking and strong natural healing power. Today's Fortune: Trust your intuition and flashes of inspiration. Today's
DQX: Try advancing through the quests.

341726.あなたの未来には 希望があふれています。\n直感や ひらめきを信じることで\n理:

341728.【星】の逆位置は 高すぎる理想のせいで\n進むべき目標を見失っていると 示してい:
The reversed [Star] card suggests you've lost sight of your true goals because your ideals are too lofty. Take a breath and reassess your

Even if you've got leeway, don't drop your guard. Health: If something's bothering you, get it checked. Today's Fortune: Step back,

341729.あなたは今 理想が高すぎるあまり\nそれに たどり着けないことで\n自信を なく:
Are you losing confidence right now because your standards are too high and you can't seem to reach them? Take a fresh look at the things
you love, the things you can do, and the things you're good at. Then, reset your goals. If you do that, you'll definitely be able to

341731.【月】の正位置は 目の前の状況が見えず\n不安や 心配をつのらせている状態を示し:
